My wheat plot is small, and here in SNNP I try to use what I can afford on the land I own. For this season, I will apply some chemical fertilizer because wheat needs it, but not too much since inputs are costly and sometimes arrive late. I will also use some manure or compost from home if available, keep using local seed because improved seed is hard to get, and I will not irrigate because this plot depends on the rains.
